Vanessa / Ben — I reviewed DataWave's redline and the evidence_spec. My recommended positions below are intentionally practical so we can close quickly without sacrificing our core risk tolerances. I attached a marked proposal (redwood_indemnity_proposal_marked.pdf).

Summary of proposed Redwood positions (with commercial fallbacks):

A) Scope of indemnity
- Redwood will defend & indemnify Customer for third-party claims of IP infringement arising from Model Outputs produced by Redwood-hosted models that have not been modified by the Customer, where the claim is about the output itself ("Redwood Model Outputs").
- We will exclude claims arising from (i) Customer-modified models, (ii) Customer-supplied model artifacts, or (iii) prompts and data the Customer provided that directly incorporate third-party proprietary content.

B) Defense control and counsel
- Redwood requests primary defense control with right to select counsel subject to Customer approval (reasonable). If Redwood assumes defense, Customer will cooperate and may participate in the defense. We will agree to keep Customer informed of material decisions.

C) Cap and remedies
- Proposed default cap: the greater of (i) 12 months of committed Order Form spend, or (ii) $1M.
- Insurance offset: any proceeds from insurance will reduce Redwood's liability.
- For high-risk use cases (customer collects PII/regulated data), propose an escrow alternative: a dedicated escrow fund (one-time amount equal to 3 months spend) to be drawn only for IP verdicts above the cap. This is an optional commercial add-on.

D) Evidence & triage process
- Customer must provide timely written notice and reasonable evidence. Redwood will have the right to examine technical logs and reproduce the output. If the claim is attributable to Customer-provided artifacts, Redwood may decline defense and indemnity.

Fallback commercial options (to offer on the call):
1) Lower cap in exchange for a 24-month committed spend minimum.
2) Full defense control but joint selection of counsel for claims > $250k.
3) Limited carveout language allowing Customer to retain their counsel at their cost but Redwood to reimburse reasonable defense costs up to the cap if we decline control.

I recommend we present option B (defend Redwood Model Outputs; cap tied to committed spend) as our preferred path and keep options 1 and 3 as negotiable concessions.

Agree with Kimberly's recommended framing. A few commercial notes from my side:

- DataWave is mid-size; they sign quickly if the cap is predictable and tied to spend. Suggest setting the cap to "12 months committed spend (calculated at current order form rates)" rather than a flat $1M — easier to justify to their procurement.
- Offer the escrow as a priced add-on. Sales can model the uplift vs. risk and present it cleanly.
- Recommend we avoid open-ended defense-control concessions. We can allow reasonable counsel approval but preserve our right to manage strategy.

If you want, Vanessa, I can draft a 1-page tradeoff memo for the customer call that summarizes: (i) what Redwood will defend, (ii) exclusions, (iii) cap mechanics, and (iv) evidence & cooperation steps.

Ben Carter

Emma — thanks for the patience while we reviewed. Below is our proposal to resolve the open indemnity items so you can take it back to procurement/legal for an expedited sign.

Proposal summary (commercial + legal):
- Redwood will defend & indemnify DataWave for third-party IP claims that are solely attributable to Redwood Model Outputs (i.e., outputs generated by our hosted models without Customer modifications).
- Exclusions: claims caused by Customer-supplied models, Customer modifications, or Customer prompts/data that reproduce third-party proprietary content.
- Defense control: Redwood will assume primary defense control and may select counsel; Customer approval of counsel will not be unreasonably withheld. Customer may participate in the defense and will provide timely cooperation.
- Cap: liability limited to the greater of (i) 12 months of committed Order Form spend, or (ii) $1,000,000. Insurance proceeds will offset Redwood’s liability.
- Escrow option: for additional comfort, we can offer a priced escrow fund equal to 3 months committed spend to be drawn only for IP verdicts above the cap.
- Evidence & triage: DataWave to provide prompt written notice and relevant logs/evidence. Redwood may request reproduction steps to attribute the output.

Attached is a marked Order Form reflecting the language above plus a 1-page tradeoff memo for procurement. If that looks good, I will send a DocuSign with the updated Order Form and the escrow addendum (optional) for signature.
